title: 天黑請閉眼
subject: a Friday werewolf-game night at a board-game café where she peeks during the night phase, sees the boy she likes is the werewolf, and keeps voting the wrong way to save him
caption: Mandarin UK garage in the late-1990s two-step style. A shuffling two-step drum machine with skipped kicks and crisp swung hi-hats; a rubbery sub bass sliding between notes; warm organ stabs playing minor seventh chords; soft electric piano filling the gaps; a filtered string pad under the chorus. Clean late-night club mix, dry close vocal, light sidechain pump. Female voice, a light airy mezzo, conversational and teasing in the verses, stacked harmonies on the chorus. 132 BPM, F minor. Flirty, hushed and lit up. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop, no drum and bass breakbeats, no sampled voice snippets.
lyrics:
[Intro - two-step drums and organ chords]

[Verse 1]
禮拜五晚上 桌遊店最裡面那一桌
法官發完牌 說不可以偷看
你把牌蓋好 喝一口奶茶
說你是平民 眼睛都不眨

[Pre-Chorus]
大家都在推理 我只顧著看
你的吸管 又轉了三圈

[Chorus]
天黑請閉眼 我偷偷瞄一眼
看到你舉手 指著我的好朋友
天亮了 你說你好怕
我就跟著你 一起投錯人

[Verse 2]
第三輪 我被你刀了
只能坐旁邊 一句話都不能講
你跟預言家 吵到拍桌子
整桌都信你 連我都差點信了

[Pre-Chorus]
散場走到門口 你回過頭
問我 你都有偷看 對不對

[Chorus]
天黑請閉眼 這次我不閉眼
你也睜開眼 對我笑一下
你說下禮拜 坐你旁邊
我們同一邊 一起騙整桌

[Outro - organ chords and filtered drums fading]
天亮了
我們還是同一邊
